mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that may lead to economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a weakening in housing and retail sectors, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced aggregate demand.
failure_condition: Negative returns are not observed in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a federal funds rate hike above 2.5% triggers monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 950,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when HOUST is below 950.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening supply chain and labor market contraction, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: Negative returns are not observed in > 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS growth > 1.5% YoY), a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
